data.description:
The Brimstone Witch is a post-Moon Lord NPC vendor that will spawn once the following conditions have been met:
There is an empty house.
Supreme Witch, Calamitas has been defeated.
When threatened by enemies, she will defend herself with Brimstone Hellblasts.

</p>
<ul><li>There is an empty house.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/Supreme_Witch,_Calamitas" title="Supreme Witch, Calamitas">Supreme Witch, Calamitas</a> has been defeated.</li></ul>
<p>When threatened by <a href="/wiki/Enemies" title="Enemies">enemies</a>, she will defend herself with Brimstone Hellblasts.
</p>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Enchant">Enchant</span></h2>
<dl><dd><i>For a full explanation on this mechanic, see <a href="/wiki/Enchantment" title="Enchantment">Enchantment</a>.</i></dd></dl>
<p>For an expensive price, the Brimstone Witch is capable of <a href="/wiki/Enchant" class="mw-redirect" title="Enchant">enchanting</a> the player's items, granting them new power with some drawback. She is also capable of "exhuming" certain items, transforming them into entirely new items.

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="History">History</span></h2>
<div class="history_section_hat_note"><div class="history_page_link"><a href="/wiki/History:Brimstone_Witch" title="History:Brimstone Witch">edit</a></div><span class="note-text">These history sections are still a <a href="/wiki/Calamity_Mod_Wiki:Version_history" title="Calamity Mod Wiki:Version history">work-in-progress</a>, and may not yet contain changes relevant to the current version of the Calamity Mod.</span></div>
<ul><li><b><a href="/wiki/2.2.0" title="2.2.0">2.2.0</a></b>: Fixed enchantment UI sometimes not drawing the coin cost properly.</li></ul>
<ul><li><b><a href="/wiki/2.1.2" title="2.1.2">2.1.2</a></b>: Fixed enchantment menu not scaling properly with the UI scale setting.</li></ul>
<ul><li><b><a href="/wiki/2.1.0" title="2.1.0">2.1.0</a></b>:
<ul><li>Buffed attack damage from 50 to 300, and random extra cooldown from 50 to 15.</li>
<li>Now vulnerable to cold and sickness debuffs, but resistant to heat debuffs.</li>
<li>Decreased enchantment price from 20x the sell value to 10x the sell value, exhume price from 100x the sell value to 20x the sell value, maximum exhume price cap from <span data-info="25000000" style="white-space:nowrap" title="25 Platinum Coins">25 <img alt="Platinum Coin" src="https://terraria.wiki.gg/images/Platinum_Coin.png?81bdc9" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="14" height="16" data-file-width="14" data-file-height="16"></span> to <span data-info="10000000" style="white-space:nowrap" title="10 Platinum Coins">10 <img alt="Platinum Coin" src="https://terraria.wiki.gg/images/Platinum_Coin.png?81bdc9" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="14" height="16" data-file-width="14" data-file-height="16"></span>, and enchantment price is now affected by happiness.</li>
<li>Changes to the donor list:
<ul><li>Added the following names:
<ul><li>asokasi, ChristmadLaner, Chuck, Cosmoec Ark, Cracking cheese gromit, DefinitlyResponsible, Dizzetriya, Dokuro vibes, Dos Champion, HeWhoShallNotBeBaned, Hunyre, Hyperthermia, Idan, JmWarrior, JMww2, JOSEPH BRACKEN, JustinTheLocalToaster, Kelta7, Lazy2ns, LecTrouble, Liam Healy, Mateo Sauvege, Mediocre King, Melongun, Misako Drevis, Moe, MrDizzyG, Natalie Webb, Nyavalcade, OriasTheFloof, Oxytoxy365, Ozone-278, Patrick Nevermore, PumpkinKing, RK, Ryo Tadashi, SRMG267, tadict, Umbara, VentCrab, Vergil Cyrus, Vixcalibur, Vortex, Willye, wt55030, and Zecro.</li></ul></li>
<li>Changed the name "EternalGrayson" to "GrayAeternum".</li></ul></li>
<li>Fixed her having improper animations and visually clipping partially into the ground.</li></ul></li></ul>

The Brimstone Witch is a post-Moon Lord NPC vendor that will spawn once the following conditions have been met:

When threatened by enemies, she will defend herself with Brimstone Hellblasts.
